name: CodeSimpleQA
intro: CodeSimpleQA是一个评估代码大模型编程知识事实准确性的双语基准，包含1,498个问答对（782个英文、716个中文），覆盖15种以上编程语言和21个计算机科学领域。论文另行构建了66.9M条CodeSimpleQA-Instruct训练语料；该训练集不属于1,498题评测基准的构建流程。
org: Jian Yang, Wei Zhang, Yizhi Li, Shawn Guo, Haowen Wang, Aishan Liu, Ge Zhang, Zili Wang, Zhoujun Li,
build_method: Code WebQA、自构造与人工编写三源合并, 8名标注员独立复核, 工程师共识质检
build_method_en: Code WebQA, Self-constructed, and Human-written Source Merge, Independent Review by 8 Annotators, Engineer Consensus Quality Control
intro_en: CodeSimpleQA is a bilingual benchmark for factual accuracy in programming knowledge, containing 1,498 QA pairs (782 English and 716 Chinese) across more than 15 programming languages and 21 computer-science domains. The paper separately constructs a 66.9M-example CodeSimpleQA-Instruct training corpus; that corpus is not part of the 1,498-item evaluation benchmark build process.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2512.19424 while explicitly reconciling its internal inconsistencies. The abstract, Table 1, contributions, conclusion, and limitations consistently report 1,498 benchmark items split into 782 English and 716 Chinese items, so the diagram uses those figures rather than the isolated 1,478/762 sentence. The benchmark merges Code WebQA, self-constructed, and human-written source families; only the documented human-written branch has the explicit 1,500 candidates to 680 QA pairs to 312 retained items funnel. Eight annotators perform review and engineer consensus requires at least three approvals; the diagram avoids asserting a total engineer headcount because the main text and appendix disagree. CodeSimpleQA-Instruct is a separate 66.9M-example training corpus and is not shown as part of the evaluation benchmark construction. Evaluation grades answers as Correct, Not Attempted, or Incorrect and reports Correct, Correct Given Attempted, and F-score.
